name: MapScreen - FromBrief
description: The first meeting on a map derived from a document rather than a typed sentence. The band's start prompt names read_brief, not read_map - and it can only know that because the SCREEN passed the brief down to it. That leg is what the board-redesign merge dropped: brief stayed a declared prop and stopped being read, so every brief-started map handed its agent a prompt pointing at the emptier of the two things it could open. Compare against JustArrived, which is the same screen with no brief.
